column1: # Hand-written translation facts, merged over the generated rows of shader_facts.tsv by dm/gfx/tools/shader_split.py: key <TAB> facts JSON (same format)
# This game has no PC version, so the translator declares every fragment output float. The engine's G-buffer is (B10G11R11F, RGBA8UI, RG16UI, RGBA8UI) and its lighting pass
# reads the integer targets: through Vulkan a float output into an integer attachment is undefined (Turnip: zeros), so the deferred lighting read an empty G-buffer and the
# ground, the cliffs and the shore came out as one flat light grey (the same cause as upstream PR #411, Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter).
# So every pixel shader declares outputs 1 to 3 unsigned; a shader that does not write them is not changed by the row.
